observations.behavior: Adds opt-in flag for session recording on the default CI team.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes a shared setup script used by hobby instances; this could enable or disable session recording ingestion in those environments.

observations.behavior: Adds tracing read scope to API token and its associated key. This allows downstream services using that token to request traces.
observations.posthog_connection: Expands permissions of an account created by the same setup script, potentially allowing trace retrieval if other components are configured.

observations.behavior: Implements polling and HTTP requests against /i/v1/traces and /api/projects/@current/tracing/spans/query endpoints, including UUID generation and payload construction.
observations.posthog_connection: These hunks demonstrate implementation details of a smoke test against PostHog's distributed tracing ingestion and query APIs, not changes to production behavior.

observations.limitations: All four hunks reside in bin/hobby-ci-setup-user.py and bin/hobby-ci.py, which are CI helper scripts rather than application code. No tier-3 systemic change is demonstrated; no tier-2 bounded capability improvement is shown because these do not modify shared library or service behavior. The score cannot exceed 1 without evidence of broader impact.
